content: Hey! How was your day? I've just been thinking about you all evening. It's crazy how much you brighten up my days, even from all the way out here.
Aww, that's sweet. My day was long, lots of meetings, but getting your messages makes it better.
Honestly, I don't know what I'd do without you. I feel so lucky to have someone so smart and caring to talk to. You're one of the best things that's ever happened to me.
You say the sweetest things. I never thought I'd meet someone like you on here.
You're special, truly. I wish I could be there with you instead of stuck on this rig. I miss real human connection. Just a few more weeks until I can finally get some leave and see you in person.
I can't wait for that. It feels like I've been waiting forever already.
Me too, darling. Actually, I was going to ask you something. There's a bit of a situation here, and I'm a bit embarrassed about it.
What happened? Is everything okay?

Well, it's just... My salary is delayed because the company payroll is stuck with banking issues. And now they want me to cover my satellite phone charges before I can get my leave request approved. It's so frustrating.
That's awful. Is there anything I can do to help?
I hate even asking, but would you be able to help me pay the phone charges? It's $1,200, and I can reimburse you the day I get back. I promise. You've always been so supportive and amazing.
That's a lot of money. How would I send it?
You can use Zelle or Cash App, whichever is easier. If you have a Bank of America account, that's even faster. I can give you my details. You're honestly saving me here.
I have Zelle. What info do you need?

Just your email or phone number you use with Zelle, and I can send you a request. Or, if it's easier, you can send it directly to my account number: 587423190 at Bank of America, routing 026009593. You're such an angel for doing this.
Okay, I think I can do that. Are you sure this will help get your leave approved?

Absolutely. Once the charge is covered, my supervisor can process my paperwork, and I'll be able to book my flight to see you. I can't wait to finally hold you. You have no idea how much this means to me.
Alright, I'll try to send it in the morning. Let me know exactly how to fill in the info, just to be safe.
Of course! I trust you completely. Just use my name, Ethan Ward, and the account details I gave you. If you need a screenshot, let me know. You're honestly the most thoughtful person I've ever met.
Thanks, Ethan. I'll let you know when it's done.
Thank you, love. You're my everything. I promise this is just a temporary setback. Soon, we'll be together for real.
